title: Expo: development, builds and over-the-air updates

videos.script:
Expo is more than a way to start a React Native app. It is three services around it, and today you meet each one. {{three}}

The first is the development loop. {{loop}} Expo Go runs your app on a phone without building it, until the day your app needs native code Expo Go does not carry. Then you build your own development app.

The second is a different idea about native projects. {{generate}} Capacitor gave you android and ios to keep in git. Expo generates them, every time, from app.json, and keeps them out of git. You will generate one, delete it, and lose nothing.

The third is updates without the store. {{updates}} An update is just a bundle of JavaScript and its pictures, and you will export one. And a number, the runtime version, decides which installed apps may take it. {{runtime}} The stores have rules about what an update may change, and they are the last part of today.
